title: @wilsoon/env configuration
description: Committed configuration for a wilsoon-env project. Contains no secrets.

$schema.description: Path or URL to this schema, for editor autocomplete.

project.description: Names this project inside the store. Must not contain path separators.

provider.description: Where ciphertext is kept. Built in: local, s3, supabase, kv, aws. Needs a driver: mongodb.

options.description: Provider settings. ${VAR} in any string is read from the environment, and an unset variable is an error.

path.description: local: directory holding the store, relative to the config file.

endpoint.description: s3: endpoint for a non-AWS store. Omit for AWS.

region.description: s3: region. Defaults to us-east-1 for AWS, auto for a custom endpoint.

prefix.description: s3: key prefix inside the bucket.

profile.description: s3: profile in ~/.aws/credentials. Defaults to AWS_PROFILE, then 'default'.

forcePathStyle.description: s3: path-style URLs. Defaults to true when an endpoint is set.

accessKeyId.description: s3: prefer the environment or a profile over writing this here.

secretAccessKey.description: s3: never commit a real value. Use ${VAR}.

accountId.description: kv: Cloudflare account id. Defaults to CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID.

namespaceId.description: kv: Workers KV namespace id. Defaults to CLOUDFLARE_KV_NAMESPACE_ID.

apiToken.description: kv: prefer CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN over writing this here.

url.description: supabase: project URL. Defaults to SUPABASE_URL.

anonKey.description: supabase: anon key, used with login and row level security. Defaults to SUPABASE_ANON_KEY.

serviceKey.description: supabase: service role key. Bypasses RLS, so it is the machine option. Use ${VAR}.

uri.description: mongodb: connection string. Defaults to MONGODB_URI. Use ${VAR} rather than committing credentials.

schema.description: supabase: Postgres schema holding the table. Must also be listed under Settings > API > Exposed schemas, or PostgREST returns 406 PGRST106.

scope.description: supabase: shared = one set of rows per project, which is what a team wants. user = rows keyed by owner as well, for unrelated tenants in one project. Only "shared" is implemented; "user" additionally needs owner in the primary key.

include.description: Filename patterns to sync. * matches within one name segment.

exclude.description: Patterns to skip. Examples and templates are excluded by default because they are committed and non-secret.

recipients.description: Who can decrypt. Adding an entry grants nothing until the next push, which is why this file being reviewable matters.

name.description: Label only. Used by --as and by keys commands.

keyid.description: First 8 bytes of SHA-256 of the public key. A hint for picking a slot, never a trust decision.

pubkey.description: X25519 public key, base32 with a checksum.

files.description: Restrict this recipient to these files. Absent means every file. Enforced by omitting their key slot, not by a client-side check.

kdf.description: Argon2id cost this project expects. Checked by 'keys audit'. Raising it does not break existing vaults - each blob records what it was sealed at.

log2m.description: log2 of memory in KiB. 16 = 64 MiB. Bounded because an unvalidated exponent off a hostile blob is a denial of service.

auth.description: How to reach the store as a person rather than with a shared key. The token reaches the store and never unlocks a secret.

type.description: oidc = any OIDC issuer (PKCE or device grant). supabase = Supabase's own auth, which needs no privileged key and no issuer configuration.

issuer.description: Issuer base URL. Optional for supabase, where the project URL in options is the issuer. Must be https unless it is localhost.

clientId.description: Public client id. No secret: a published package cannot hold one.

scope.description: offline_access is what gets a refresh token back; without it every expiry means signing in again.

authorizationEndpoint.description: Only needed when the issuer publishes no /.well-known/openid-configuration.

tokenEndpoint.description: Only needed when the issuer publishes no discovery document.

deviceEndpoint.description: Only needed when the issuer publishes no discovery document. RFC 8628 device authorization endpoint.
